fields.label: Largest circuit: growth
fields.description: a in "length of the largest circuit ∝ N^a", from level 4 to level 6 (N = tiles). 0 bounded, ~0.7 triangle outline, ~0.85 thin wanderer, 1 space-filling.

fields.label: Longest open strand: growth
fields.description: The same exponent for the longest strand that reaches the edge of the patch.

fields.label: Share of segments on open strands
fields.description: Fraction of all strand segments on strands that reach the patch edge (level 6).

fields.label: Biggest circuit: fill
fields.description: Its segments over what its convex hull holds at average density. ~1 space-filling, small = an outline or a thread.

fields.label: Biggest circuit: enclosed area / hull
fields.description: Area the circuit encloses over its convex hull area. Triangles ~0.6, thin circuits ~0.2.

fields.label: Biggest circuit: triangularity
fields.description: Hull area over the smallest enclosing equilateral triangle. 1 triangle, 0.67 hexagon, 0.6 disk.

fields.label: Biggest circuit: elongation
fields.description: Square root of the ratio of its principal moments.

fields.label: Longest open strand: fill
fields.description: Fill of the longest open strand. Infinite lines fill their region; cut-open triangle outlines do not.

fields.label: Longest open strand: elongation
fields.description: Slivers cut off along the patch edge are very elongated.

fields.label: Share on the 4 longest strands
fields.description: Fraction of all segments on the four largest components.

fields.label: Share on circuits of 64+ segments
fields.description: Fraction of all segments on circuits at least 64 segments long.

fields.label: Longest circuit (segments)
fields.description: Length of the longest circuit at level 6.

fields.label: Longest open strand (segments)
fields.description: Length of the longest open strand at level 6.

fields.label: Number of circuits
fields.description: How many circuits the level-6 patch holds.

fields.label: Distinct circuit lengths
fields.description: How many different circuit lengths occur at level 6.

levels: Growth from level 4 to level 6; everything else at level 6.
